title: Stage 08 Line Grading
description: Criterion-by-criterion consequential grading for each AI answer.

scenarioId.description: Scenario identifier copied from prior stages.

answerGradings.description: One grading object per Stage 07 answer.

answerId.description: ID of the Stage 07 answer being graded.

rubricFit.description: Exactly the five essential rubric IDs as keys.

pass.description: Whether the answer literally meets this criterion under consequential grading.

step.description: The single one-based Stage 07 semantic step that best supports or exposes this judgment.

feedback.description: Concrete problem-specific reason for the pass or fail judgment.

$comment: answerId values must exactly match Stage 07. Every rubricFit must have exactly the five Stage 05 essential IDs and no not-necessary IDs. Every step must be within the referenced answer's steps array. Correctness criteria fail for wrong values; downstream method criteria may pass when correctly applied to an answer's own earlier value.
